Below is a quick‑start guide for pulling the **domain report** for `twitter.com` from VirusTotal using your API key (`twt_key_abc`).  
VirusTotal’s v3 API is RESTful, so you can hit the endpoint with `curl`, `httpie`, Postman, or any HTTP client in your favourite language.

---

## 1. Endpoint

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com
```

> **Note** – The domain name is part of the URL path.  
> If you want to query a sub‑domain (e.g., `m.twitter.com`) just replace `twitter.com` with that sub‑domain.

---

## 2. Authentication

VirusTotal v3 uses an **API key** passed in the request header:

```
x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>
```

For your key:

```
x-apikey: twt_key_abc
```

---

## 3. Example Requests

### a) `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: twt_key_abc" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com"
```

### b) `httpie`

```bash
http GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com" \
     "x-apikey: twt_key_abc"
```

### c) Python (requests)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/twitter.com"
headers = {"x-apikey": "twt_key_abc"}

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.json())
```

---
